term: epistemic establishment, skeptical suspension, infinite regress and causal dependence
resolution: The Five Modes are presented at PHI164 as five procedures of suspension (dispute, regress, relativity, hypothesis and reciprocity). The selected text does not present a checked exclusive three-branch theorem and does not name HansAlbert. Later Agrippa/Münchhausen-trilemma language is an investigation label here, not an attribution of later doctrine. A proof’s renewed demand for epistemic support differs from a cause’s actual activity and from infinite temporal history. No established starting point is read epistemically, not as a demand for a chronologically first event. The repository’s inductively GeneratedWarrant is one stipulated foundationalist account, not the meaning of all possible justification or a norm Sextus has here independently vindicated. Bare concession differs from independently defended noninferential warrant; reciprocal establishing differs from every holistic coherence criterion. Suspension is not a positive impossibility or knowledge claim.
